measurement: Built-up surface area in square kilometres
statisticsMethod: Earth Engine sum of original GHSL built_surface band using the native image projection and nominal 100 m scale.
boundaryTreatment: Earth Engine weighted reduction with fractional pixel coverage at the study-area boundary.
visualisationMethod: Dark basemap. Built-up surface from GHSL with light display-only smoothing; water from JRC Global Surface Water; streets, boundaries, railway and place names from OpenStreetMap contributors.
contextSources: © OpenStreetMap contributors (streets, boundaries, railway, place names)
limitations: GHSL built-up surface values are published dataset estimates.
Intermediate epochs include spatial-temporal interpolation or extrapolation.
Net change does not identify individual building construction.
Positive changes are displayed; decreases are not separately mapped.
Display smoothing and thresholds change appearance, not statistics.
The 100 m grid does not resolve individual buildings.
